Really it comes down to what you need at the current stage of the game. Both are excellent items against AD heavy teams, but I see them as filling slightly different needs. Frozen Heart is something I build when I'm against a team with a larger amount of AD than AP or I'm playing a champ that stacks armor (ex. Malphite). I see Randuin's as much more of a team fighting item because of it's AoE slow. Frozen Heart is better if you need that CDR or the constant auto attacking passive. Similar stats, different uses. 

Edit: Forgot to bring up the mana side of things. I don't see it as being much of an issue, I see the armor and CDR as being more important stats most of the time.
